aggressive_definition: Aggressiveness determined according to the ISUP classification; the abstract does not specify the ISUP categories or threshold used.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: The aggressiveness of PCa was determined according to the ISUP classification.
study_design: Population-based case-control study of incident prostate cancer cases and controls.
reason: The abstract analyzes total incident prostate cancer and separately states that the association was observed when aggressiveness, defined using the ISUP classification, was considered. It does not report the number of aggressive cases or an aggressive alcohol-specific effect estimate.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In addition, limiting consumption of "fast foods", sugar-sweetened drinks, and alcohol were independently associated with lower risk of PCa.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol estimate concerns overall prostate cancer risk. It must not be relabeled as aggressive merely because the study also considered aggressiveness.
